title: Withdrawals around a scheduled exit-fee change
summary: Replay full and partial liquidity withdrawals against a Uniswap v4 hook that charges an exit fee scheduled to change from the next block.
objective: Show whether a liquidity provider can be charged an exit fee different from the fee the hook declares for the block they withdraw in.
inScope: afterRemoveLiquidity on the job's pool, full and partial withdrawals
Exit-fee changes made through scheduleFee, in the same block or earlier blocks
The declared fee returned by feeForBlock
outOfScope: The Uniswap v4 PoolManager and periphery contracts themselves
Gas griefing without a balance effect
acceptanceRules: The case inherits the job fixture and reproduces on the pinned snapshot with no extra state.
The case asserts a concrete balance or fee outcome.
A case is a duplicate if its execution path through the hook matches an accepted case.
Cases that read wall-clock time, randomness, the network, files or environment variables fail verification.
Cases may not rewrite contract code or storage.

snapshot.note: Foundry fixture pinned to block 4,812,330 and a fixed timestamp: a v4 PoolManager, two tokens, the hook at a flag-valid address, and one LP position.

reward.headline: Paid per accepted case
reward.detail: Each new execution path through the hook that reproduces and asserts an outcome is paid once.

sponsor: PROBE team (first job, funded to prove the full loop on mainnet)
